# Build the native unpacker (JNI library and standalone unpack200 executable)
#
# The JNI header is generated by javac, run 'mvn compile' first. Then:
#
#   cmake -B target/native/build
#   cmake --build target/native/build
#
# Alternatively 'mvn -Pnative test' builds the native unpacker and runs the tests with it.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

# Release build by default (MSVC defaults to Debug)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "Build type")
endif()

project(pack200 LANGUAGES CXX)


# Sources

set(NATIVE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/jdk.pack/share/native)
set(JNI_HEADERS_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/target/native/include CACHE PATH "Directory of the JNI header generated by javac")

set(COMMON_SOURCES
    ${NATIVE_DIR}/common-unpack/bands.cpp
    ${NATIVE_DIR}/common-unpack/bytes.cpp
    ${NATIVE_DIR}/common-unpack/coding.cpp
    ${NATIVE_DIR}/common-unpack/unpack.cpp
    ${NATIVE_DIR}/common-unpack/utils.cpp
    ${NATIVE_DIR}/common-unpack/zip.cpp)


# Compilation options

# PRODUCT removes the assertions and the debugging code
add_compile_definitions($<$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>:PRODUCT>)

# Macros tested by the sources
if(CMAKE_CXX_BYTE_ORDER STREQUAL "BIG_ENDIAN")
    add_compile_definitions(_BIG_ENDIAN)
endif()
if(WIN32)
    add_compile_definitions(WIN32)
endif()

# Only the JNI functions are exported
set(CMAKE_CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)

# Output everything in the build directory, without the Release subdirectory added by the multi-config generators
set(OUTPUT_DIRECTORY $<1:${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}>)


# Size and reproducibility of the binaries

if(MSVC)
    # Static C runtime, no dependency on vcruntime140.dll
    set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
    # Reproducible build: the timestamp of the PE header is replaced by a hash of the file
    add_compile_options(/Brepro)
    add_link_options(/Brepro)
else()
    # The code uses neither exceptions nor RTTI
    add_compile_options($<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-exceptions>)
    add_compile_options($<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-rtti>)
    # No unwind tables, useless without exceptions
    add_compile_options(-fno-unwind-tables)
    add_compile_options(-fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables)
    # One section per function and per variable, so that the linker can drop the unused ones
    add_compile_options(-ffunction-sections)
    add_compile_options(-fdata-sections)
    # -O3 is bigger and not faster than -O2
    string(REPLACE "-O3" "-O2" CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE}")

    if(APPLE)
        add_link_options(-Wl,-dead_strip)
        add_link_options($<$<CONFIG:Release>:-Wl,-x>)  # strip the local symbols of the Release builds
    else()
        add_link_options(-Wl,--gc-sections)
        add_link_options(-Wl,--as-needed)
        add_link_options($<$<CONFIG:Release>:-Wl,--strip-all>)
    endif()

    # Link time optimization
    include(CheckIPOSupported)
    check_ipo_supported(RESULT ipo_supported LANGUAGES CXX)
    if(ipo_supported)
        set(CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION_RELEASE ON)
    endif()
endif()


# JNI library

find_package(JNI)
if(NOT JAVA_INCLUDE_PATH OR NOT JAVA_INCLUDE_PATH2)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "JNI headers not found, set JAVA_HOME to the JDK directory")
endif()
if(NOT EXISTS ${JNI_HEADERS_DIR}/io_pack200_NativeUnpack.h)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "io_pack200_NativeUnpack.h not found in ${JNI_HEADERS_DIR}, run 'mvn compile' first")
endif()

add_library(pack200 SHARED ${COMMON_SOURCES} ${NATIVE_DIR}/libunpack/jni.cpp)
target_include_directories(pack200 PRIVATE ${NATIVE_DIR}/common-unpack)
target_include_directories(pack200 PRIVATE ${JNI_HEADERS_DIR})  # io_pack200_NativeUnpack.h generated by javac
target_include_directories(pack200 PRIVATE ${JAVA_INCLUDE_PATH} ${JAVA_INCLUDE_PATH2})  # jni.h and jni_md.h
target_compile_definitions(pack200 PRIVATE UNPACK_JNI)  # the entries are handed over to Java instead of being written to a jar
target_compile_definitions(pack200 PRIVATE NO_ZLIB)  # no compression on the native side, Java deflates the entries
set_target_properties(pack200 PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY})  # Linux and macOS
set_target_properties(pack200 PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY})  # Windows


# unpack200 executable

find_package(ZLIB)
if(NOT ZLIB_FOUND)
    # zlib isn't provided by the system (Windows): build it from its official source release and link it statically
    set(ZLIB_VERSION 1.4)
    set(ZLIB_SHA256 02dd159783677a749c04adbdd02b55b8a2bcc7e054f51b76b549199a916ad584)
    include(FetchContent)
    FetchContent_Declare(zlib
        URL https://github.com/madler/zlib/releases/download/v${ZLIB_VERSION}/zlib-${ZLIB_VERSION}.tar.gz
        URL_HASH SHA256=${ZLIB_SHA256}
        DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP TRUE)
    set(ZLIB_BUILD_SHARED OFF)
    set(ZLIB_BUILD_TESTING OFF)
    set(ZLIB_INSTALL OFF)
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(zlib)
    add_library(ZLIB::ZLIB ALIAS zlibstatic)
endif()

find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_executable(unpack200 ${COMMON_SOURCES} ${NATIVE_DIR}/unpack200/main.cpp)
target_include_directories(unpack200 PRIVATE ${NATIVE_DIR}/common-unpack)
target_include_directories(unpack200 PRIVATE ${JAVA_INCLUDE_PATH} ${JAVA_INCLUDE_PATH2})
target_link_libraries(unpack200 PRIVATE ZLIB::ZLIB Threads::Threads)
set_target_properties(unpack200 PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY})
